requirement: Getting started's header button is a two-way switch: Hide from account menu / Show in account menu, the screen stays open, and the account menu row comes back at once

oracle.invariant: Not hidden: [data-action='hide-menu'] reads 'Hide from account menu' (aria-label the same, data-state='shown', title mentions Settings › Help & about). Pressing it posts /api/onboarding/menu-hide only, never POST /api/onboarding; the screen stays open. Hidden: the same button reads 'Show in account menu' (data-state='hidden', title 'Puts the Getting started row back in the account menu.'); pressing it posts /api/onboarding/menu-show and the account flag is cleared; the screen stays open. An account that hid the row opens the screen on 'Show in account menu'. A refused door (403) keeps the screen and the button says what the account says. The account menu row goes on Hide and comes back with its count on Show, without a reload. accountStore.showMenu posts /api/onboarding/menu-show with the session cookie, never rejects, warns once; the desktop surface sends both to the account door. POST /api/onboarding/menu-show answers {menuHiddenAt: null} and clears the flag (GET reads null; a later hide records a new time); 401 NOT_SIGNED_IN without a session, 403 CSRF_ORIGIN from a sibling host; one account never shows another's row.
